name: PPI
consensus_source: No economist poll found for September PPI; only a prediction-market estimate, not recorded
read: PPI accelerated: headline 1.343% m/m (prior 0.47%), 6.338% y/y; core 0.681% m/m (prior 0.246%), 4.978% y/y. No consensus found. Confirms CPI energy pass-through and points to firmer CPI; yields up, USD up, equities down.

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
